m: 1. मी cl. 9. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxxi, 4) मीनाति, मीनीते (Ved. also मिनाति and मिनोति; मीयते or मीयते [Dhātup. xxvi, 28]; मिमीतस्, मिमीयात् [?]; pf. मिमाय, RV.; मीमय, AV.; ममौ, मिम्ये Gr.; aor. अमासीत्, अमास्त Gr.; मेष्ट, AV.; aor. Pass. अमायि, Br.; Prec. मीयात्, मासीष्ट Gr.; fut. माता, मास्यति, ˚ते Gr.; मेष्यते, Br.; inf. -मियम्, -मिये, RV.; मेतोस्, Br.; ind.p. मीत्वा, -मीय, -माय, Gr.), to lessen, diminish, destroy (Ā. and Pass. to perish, disappear, die), RV.; AV.; Br.; Up.; BhP.; to lose one's way, go astray, RV.; to transgress, violate, frustrate, change, alter, RV.; AV. : Caus. मापयति aor. अमीमपत्. See प्र-√ मी; Desid. मित्सति, ˚ते Gr.: Intens. मेमीयते, मेमयीति, मेमेति, ib.
मी [cf. Gk. μινύω ; Lat. minuere; Slav. mǐnij; Germ. minniro, minre, minder; Angl.Sax. min.]
2. मी See मन्यु-मी.
3. मी cl. 1. 10. P. मयति or माययति, to go, move, Dhātup. xxxiv, 18; to understand, Vop.
a: मी — {vI.v} {c9c} U. (मीनाति, मीनीते; seldom used in classical literature) 1 To kill, destroy, hurt, injure. --2 To lessen, diminish. --3 To change, alter. --4 To transgress, violate. --5 To disappear, be lost. --6 To stray, go astray. {vII.v} P., {c10c} U. (मयति, माययति-ते) 1 To go, move. --2 To know, understand (गतिमत्ययोः). {vIII.v} {c4c} A. (मीयते) To die, perish.

a: मीढ्वस् — a. 1 Bountiful, liberal. --2 Discharging semen.

m: मील् cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xv, 10) मीलति (rarely Ā. ˚ते; pf. मिमील, Kāv.; aor. अमीलीत् Gr.; fut. मीलिता, मीलिष्यति, ib.; ind.p. -मील्य, RV.), to close the eyes, Gīt.; to close (intrans., said of the eyes), wink, twinkle, Hariv.; Kāv.; Pur.; (= मिल्) to assemble, be collected, Uttarar. : Caus. मीलयति (ep. also ˚ते; aor. अमिमीलत्, or अमीमिलत्, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 3), to cause to close, close (eyes, blossoms &c.), Kāv.; Pur. : Desid. मिमीलिषति Gr.: Intens. मेमील्यते, मेमील्ति, ib.
a: मील् — {c1c} P. (मीलति, मीलित) 1 To close (as the eyes), close or contract the eve-lids, wink, twinkle; पत्रे बिभ्यति मीलति क्षणमपि क्षिप्रं तदालोकनात् Gīt. 10. --2 To close, be closed or shut (as eyes or flowers); तयनयुगममीलत् Śi. 11. 2; तस्या मिमीलतुर्नेत्रे Bk. 14. 54. --3 To fade, disappear, vanish. --4 To meet or be collected (for मिल्). --Caus. ( मीलयति-ते) To cause to shut, close, shut (eyes, flowers &c.); न लोचनं मीलयितुं विषहे Ki. 3. 36; शेषान्मासान्गमय चतुरो लोचने मीलयित्वा Me. 110.

closing (intrans., said of eyes and flowers), Kir., Sch.; Sāh.
(in rhet.) a covert or concealed simile (cf. मीलित), Pratāp.
a: मीलनं — [मील् ल्युट्] 1 Closing of the eyes, winking, twinkling. --2 Closing the eyes. --3 The closing of a flower. --4 (In Rhet.) A concealed simile; see मीलित below.

m: मीलिका f. black brass, L. (v.l. निलिका).
मीलिक See नील-म्˚

s: tri, (mIla + ktaH .) apraPullam । tatparyyAyaH । saNkucitam 2 nidrARam 3 mudritam 4 । iti hemacandraH ॥ (alaNkAraviSezaH । yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe । 10 । 115 । (“mIlitaM vastuno guptiH kenacit tulyalakzmaRA .”)
v: tri॰ mIla--kta । 1 apraPulle 2 saNkucite ca “mIlitaM yadaBirAmatADike” iti kAvyaprakASaH ।
m: मीलित mfn. one who has closed his eyes, sleepy (only compar. ˚त-तर), ŚBr.
closed, obstructed (opp. to मुक्त), PañcavBr.
closed, unblown, partly opened (as eyes, blossoms &c.), Kāv.; Pur.
disappeared, ceased to be, BhP.
met, assembled, gathered together, Rājat.

(in. rhet.) an implied simile (in which the similarity between two objects is only implied, as in the example: ‘women clothed in white are invisible in the moonlight, therefore they are as bright as moonlight’), Kpr.; Kuval.
a: मीलित — p. p. [मील्-क्त] 1 Shut, closed. --2 Twinkled. --3 Half-opened, unblown. --4 Vanished, disappeared. --5 Assembled, gathered (for मिलित). --तं (In Rhet.) A figure of speech in which the difference or distinction between two objects is shown to be completely obscured on account of their similarity, whether natural or artificial, in some respects; it is thus defined by Mammaṭa: --समेन लक्ष्मणा वस्तु वस्तुना यन्निगृह्यते . निजेनागंतुना वापि तन्मीलितमिति स्मृतं .. K. P. 10.

m: मीम् cl. 1. P. मीमति, to move; to sound, Dhātup. xiii, 25.
a: मीम् — {c1c} P. (मीमति) 1 To go, move. --2 To sound.

DarmmaSAstrARi kftAni । tatrottaramImAMsA caturaDyAyAtmikA vedavyAsapraRItA brahmanirUpikA । asyA nAma vedAntaH । aparADyAyacatuzwayaM saNkarzaRapraRItaM upAsanAkARqaM zaqdarSanabahirBUtam ॥ * ॥ darSapUrRamAsArTakatvena tacCezatvam । 3 । caturTe godohanasya puruzArTatvaprayuktyA anuzWAnaM na tu kratvarTatvaprayuktyetyevamAdayaH । 4 । paYcame kramaniyativiDeyatvAdayaH । 5 । zazWe kartturaDikAro nAnDAderityAdayaH । 6 । saptame samAnamitaracCyenena ityAdi pratyakzavacanenAgnihotrAdinAmnAnumitavacanena ca sAmAnyato'tideSaH । 7 । azwame sOryyaM caruM nirbbapedityatra nirvvApastadDitena devatAnirddeSaH ekadEvatattvamOzaDadravyakatvamityAdinA liNgenAgneyapuroqASetikarttavyatAnAnyasyetyevamAdiviSezAtideSaH । 8 । navame prakftAvagnaye yuzwaM nirvvapAmIti paWite mantre vikftO sOryyacarAvagnipadaparityAgena sUryyapadaprakzepeRa sUryyAya yuzwaM nirvvapAmItyevamAdirUhaH । 9 । daSame kfzRalezu codakaprAptasyAvaGAtasya vituzIkaraRAsamBavena lopa ityevamAdirvvADaH । 10 । ekAdaSe bahUnAmAgneyAdInAM praDAnAnAM sakfdanuzWitena prayAjAdyaNgenopakAra ityAdi tantram । 11 । dbAdaSe praDAnasya paSorupakArAya anuzWitena prayAjAdyaNgena paSvaNgapuroqASe'pyupakAra ityAdiprasaNgaH । 12 ॥ (etadaDyAyapratipAdyArTAnAM vivaraRaM yaTA, -- ‘praTamADyAyasya praTame pAde viDirUpaM mAnamIritam । dvitIye'rTavAdarUpam arTavAdo mantrasyApyupalakzakaH । tftIye smftirUpam । smftirAcAramapyupalakzayati । caturTe udBiccitrAdinAmarUpam । dbitIyADyAyasya praTame pAde AKyAtamevApUrvvaboDakam । apUrvvasadBAva ityAdikaH karmmaBedacintopayukta upodGAto varRitaH । dvitIye DAtuBedapunaruktyAdiBiH karmmaBedaH । tftIye raTantarAdInAM karmmaBedaprAmARyApavAdaH । caturTe nityakAmyayoH prayogayorBedaH । tftIyADyAyasya praTame pAde SezatvaboDakAnAM SrutiliNgAdInAM maDye SrutirvicAritA । dvitIye liNgam । tftIye vAkyaprakaraRAdi । caturTe nivItopavItAdizvarTavAdatvaviDitvAdinirRayahetuH SrutyAdeH parasparaviroDasadasadBAvaH । paYcame pratipattikarmmARi । zazWe'nAraByADItAni । saptame bahupraDAnopakArakaprayAjAdIni । azwame yAjamAnAni । caturTADyAyasya praTame pAde praDAnaBUtAmikzAdaDyAnayanasya prayojiketyAdi praDAnaprayoktftvaM vicAritam । dbitIye tvapraDAnaM vatsApakaraRaM SAKAcCede prayojakamityAdyapraDAnaprayoktftvam । tftIye juhUparRamayItvAderapApaSlokaSravaRAdiPalaBAvABAvacintA । caturTe rAjasUyagatajaGanyANgAkzadyUtAdicintA । paYcamADyAyasya praTame pAde SrutyarTapAWAdiBiH kramo nirUzitaH । dvitIye vAjapeyagatezu saptadaSasu paSuzvekEkaDarmmasamApanamityAdikramaviSezaH । tftIye paYcaprayAjAdInAmAvarttanenEkAdaSyamityAdivfdDiH । adamyagrahacitriRyoranAvfttirityAdi vfdDyaBAvaH । caturTe kramaniyAmakAnAM SrutyarTapAWAdInAM prabaladurbbalaBAvaH । zazWADyAyasya praTame pAde karmmADikAraH । kartturastyanDAdernAsti striyA asti । yo'sti sa ca patyA sahetyevamAdinADikArI nirUpitaH । dvitIye satrADikAriRAM pratyekaM kftsnaM Palam । darSapOrRamAsayoH kartrEkyaniyamaH kAmyakarmmasamApanIyamityevamAdayo'DikAriDarmmA uktAH tftIye dravyasya pratiniDirasti । devAdInAmagnyAdInAmaDikAriRAYca sa nAstItyAdinirUpaRam । caturTe padArTalopanaM vicAritam । avattanASe satyAjyena yajet । iqAdyarTanASe sati SezAnnagrAhyamityAdikam । paYcame kAlAparADena candrodaye satyaByudayezwiH prAyaScittam । jyotizwomasyEkAdayodIkzyAH । dbAdaSAhasya dbAdaSadIkzyA ityAdi nirUpitam । zazWe satrADikAriRastulyakalpA eva satraM viprasyEvetyevamAdikaM cintitam । saptame pitrAdikaM na deyam । mahABUmirna deyetyevamAdideyavicAraH । azwame lOkikAgnAvupanayanahomaH । sTapatIzwistaTEvetyevamAdyagnivicAraH kftaH । saptamADyAyasya praTame pAde samAnamitaracCyenenetyAdipratyakzavacanAtideSaH । dbitIye pUrvvoktAtideSasya Sezo vicAritaH । tftIye'gnihotranAmnAtideSaH । caturTe nirvvApOzaDadravyAdiliNgAtideSaH । azwamADyAyasya praTame pAde spazwena liNgenAtideSaviSezaH । tadyaTA sOryyacarAvatideSakAni nirvvApastadDitena devatAnirddeSa ekadevatAtvamOzaDadravyakatvamityAdIni spazwAnyAgneyaliNgAni । dvitIye tvaspazwErliNgEratideSaH । tadyaTA vAjine haviHsAmAnyena liNgena payoviDyanto'tidiSyate tatra liNgamaspazwam । SIGraM tadbudDyanutpAdanAt । tftIye prabalena liNgenAtideSaH । tadyaTA । ABicArikezwAvAgnAvEzRavasArasvatabArhaspatyezu haviHzu tritvena liNgena yaTAkramamAgneyAdiviDyante prApte dbidevatyatvena liNgena praTama AgnAvEzRave tftIyasyAgnIzomIyasya viDyanto'tidizwaH । prabalaYca dvidevatyatvam । SabdoccAraRamAtreRa sahasA pratiBAsAt । kramastu vilambitapratItyA durbbalaH । caturTe darvvihomezvatideSo'pohyate । navamADyAyasya praTame pAde upodGAtapUrvvakamUhavicAraprAramBaH । tatra prayAjAdayo DarmmA apUrvvaprayuktAH । avaGAtamantrAdizvavivakzitaM brIhyagnyAdisvarUpaM sADanaviSezatvamAtraM vivakzitamityAdirUpopodGAtaH । savitraSvipUzaSabdAnAM vikftizu nAstyUhaH । agniSabdasyAstyUha ityAdi UhavicArAramBaH । dvitIye saparikaraH sAmohaH । tftIye mantrohaH । caturTe mantrohaprasaNgApatito vicAraH । daSamADyAyasya praTame pAde bADaheturdvAralopo nirUpitaH । tadyaTA svayaM kftA vedirBavatItyatra vedinizpAdanarUpasya dbArasya lopena nizpAdakAnAmudDananAdInAM bADaH । kfzRalezu vituzIkaraRarUpasya dbArasya lopenAvaGAtasya bADaH । dvitIye saMkzepeRoktasya dvAralopasya bahuBirudAharaRErvistAraH । tftIye bADakAraRaM kAryyEkatvam । tadyaTA prakftO gavASvAdidakziRAyAH ftvikparikrayaH kAryyam । taTA vikftirUpe BUnAmnyekAhe DenurUpAyA dakziRAyAstadeva kAryyam tato DenvA gavASvAdidakziRAvikftO codakaprAptA bADyate । caturTe nakzatrezwivihitA upahomAScodakaprAptErnArizwahomEH saha samuccIyante ityAdiH samuccayaH । paYcame zoqaSigrahaH prakftigAmI । sa cAgrayaRapAtrAdeva grahItavya ityAdivADaprasaNgAgato grahAdivicAraH । zazWe sAmatfce geyamityAdirbADaprasaNgAgataH sAmavicAraH । saptame paSvaNgezu havirBedaH । gfhameDIyamapUrvvakarmmetyAdirbADaprasaNgAgataH prakIrRavicAraH । azwamenAnuyAjezvitiparyyudAso na soma ityarTavAdo nAtirAtra iti pratizeDa ityAdirbADopayukto naYarTavicAraH । ekAdaSADyAyasya praTame pAde tantrasyopodDAto varRitaH । dvitIye tantrAvApO saMkzepeRoktO । tftIye tantramudAharaRabAhulyena prapaYcitam । caturTe taTEvAvApaH prapaYcitaH । dbAdaSADyAyasya praTame pAde paSuDarmmARAM paSupuroqASe prasaNgaH । sOmikabederuttarakAlInakarmmasu prasaNga ityAdi vicAraH । dbitIye savanIyapaSostantritvam । na tu savanIyapuroqASAnAm । vikftistantriRI na prakftiH । anvAramBaRIyA vikftizvapi syAt । na tu prakftAvevetyAdivicAraH । tftIye tvagvAsasoH samuccayaH । ADAragatAnAmfjutvasantatattvA dInAM samuccaya ityAdikaM prAGAnyena । yavabrohyorvvikalpa ityAdikaM samuccayApavAdatvenetyuBayaM cintitam । caturTe cEndrAbArhaspatyayAjyAnuvAkyayugalayorvvikalpa ityAdikaM prADAnyena । yAjyAnuvAkyayoH samuccaya ityAdikaM vikalpApavAdatvenetyuBayaM cintitam । tadevaM dbAdaSADyAyagatezu zazwisaMKyakezu pAdezu pratipAdyA arTAH saMgfhItAH .” ityaDikaraRamAlA ॥ uttaramImAMsADyAyapAdapatipAdyArTA yaTA, -- “SAstraM brahmavicArAKyamaDyAyAH syuScaturvviDAH । samanvagAviroDO dbO sADanaYcaPalantaTA ॥ samanvaye spazwaliNgamaspazwatvepyupAsyagam । jYeyagaM padamAtraYca cintyaM pAdezvanukramAt ॥ dbitIye m: मीमांसा f. profound thought or reflection or Consideration, investigation, examination, discussion, ŚBr.; TĀr.
theory (cf. काव्य-म्˚)

‘examination of the Vedic text’, N. of one of the 3 great divisions of orthodox Hindū philosophy (divided into 2 systems, viz. the Pūrva-mīmāṃsā or Karma-mīmāṃsā by Jaimini, concerning itself chiefly with the correct interpretation of Vedic ritual and text, and usually called the Mīmāṃsā; and the Uttara-mīmāṃsā or Brahma-mīmāṃsā or Śārīraka-mīmāṃsā by Bādarāyaṇa, commonly styled the Vedānta and dealing chiefly with the nature of Brahmă or the one universal Spirit), IW. 46; 98 &c.
a: मीमांसा — [मान्-विचारे स्वार्थे सन् अ] 1 Deep reflection, inquiry, examination, investigation; रसगंगाधरनाम्नीं करोति कुतुकेन काव्यमीमांसां R. G.; सैषा आनंदस्य मीमांसा भवति T. Up.; so दत्तक˚, अलंकार˚ &c. --2 N. of one of the six chief darsanas or systems of Indian philosophy. (It was originally divided into two systems:--the पूर्वमीमांसा or कर्ममीमांसा founded by Jaimini, and the उत्तरमीमांसा or ब्रह्ममीमांसा ascribed to Bādarāyaṇa; but the two systems have very little in common between them, the first concerning itself chiefly with the correct interpretation of the ritual of the Veda and the settlement of dubious points in regard to Vedic texts; and the latter dealing chiefly with the nature of Brahman or the Supreme Spirit. The पूर्वमीमांसा is, therefore, usually styled only मीमांसा or the Mīmāṃsā, and the उत्तरमीमांसा, वेदांत which, being hardly a sequel of Jaimini's system, is now considered and ranked separately); मीमांसाकृ तमुन्ममाथ सहसा हस्ती मुतिं जैमिनिं Pt. 2. 33. --Comp. --कारः --कृत् m. N. of Jaimini.

a: मीनः — [मी-नक्] 1 A fish; सुप्तमीन इव ह्रदः R. 1. 73; मीनो नु हंत कतमां गतिमभ्युपैतु Bv. 1. 17. --2 The twelfth sign of the zodiac (Pisces). --3 The first incarnation of Viṣṇu; see मत्स्यावतार. --Comp. --अंडं roe, fish-spawn --(डा) moist sugar. --आ घातिन्, घातिन् m. {1} a fisherman. {2} a crane. --आलयः the sea. --केतनः the god of love. --गंधः an epithet of Satyavatī. --गंधिका a pond, pool of water. --रंकः, --रंगः a kingfisher.

k.v: पृथुरोमा झषो मत्स्यो मीनो वैसारिणोऽण्डजः। विसारः शकुली चाथ गडकः शकुलार्भकः॥

m: मीन—धावन-तोय n. water in which fish have been washed, Suśr.
मीन—ध्वज m. = -केतन, HYogaś.

s: [n] puM, (mInaM hantIti । hana + RiniH .) vakaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ matsyaGAtake, tri ॥

m: मीन—घातिन् m. ‘fish-killer’, a fisherman, L.
a crane, L.

मीन—गन्धा f. N. of Satyavatī, Cat. (cf. मत्स्य-ग्˚).

s: strI, (mInagoDikAnAmAvAso'tra .) jalASayaH । yaTA, -- ‘palvalaM dIrGikA vApI yazwikA mInagoDikA .’ iti trikARqaSezaH ॥

m: मीन—केतन m. ‘fish-bannered’, the God of love, L.
